title: RoboDK workflows and connector status
description: Explore RoboDK workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

RoboDK

RoboDK

RoboDK supports offline robot programming, simulation and cell calibration workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a robot cell

Begin with the selected part, stock, machine or cell layout. In the intended RoboDK preview, build a robot cell; the visible result is a process setup with work coordinates, resources and target geometry visible. Review orientation, reach, tooling and fixture assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Generate an offline program

Use the chosen operations, tools or robot tasks. In the intended RoboDK preview, generate an offline program; the visible result is a generated path or production sequence over the same setup. Review clearance, collisions, limits, feeds and operation order before accepting or exporting it.

Check reach and collision

Start from the simulated material removal, robot motion or process results. In the intended RoboDK preview, check reach and collision; the visible result is a verification view with remaining stock, reach or cycle data exposed. Review collisions, code target, cycle time and safe human approval before accepting or exporting it.
